title: Gama: Galician Metrical Analyzer
description:
Metrical scansion of Galician poetry. For each line of a poem, Gama gives the number of metrical syllables, the stressed syllables and the line type (e.g. endecasílabo melódico puro).

Scansion has two steps: preprocessing (spelling normalization with a KenLM language model and vocabularies, and other changes such as identifying lexically unstressed words with the Stanza tagger) and scansion, with a Galician adaptation of Jumper.
